integrity: Symbolic proof establishes the infinite statement; independent exhaustive tests check complete identifying-code subsets only for m=4,5,6,7 and all predicted optimum exchanges through m=8. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The equality-case, counting, and token-jumping reconfiguration classification holds only for the Cartesian graph K_3 square K_m with integers m >= 4. It does not determine diameter, mixing time, or the m=3 boundary. Existing scalar identifying-code minimum is credited to Goddard and Wash. Earlier equivalent descriptions in unindexed literature cannot be excluded.
title: Minimum identifying-code exchanges in three-row rook graphs
